reviews.text:
Keka and Mika make you feel so happy when they're there.
Very professional and friendly, the service is unbeatable.

We're thrilled with Guacanda. They're incredibly friendly, caring, and very respectful of dogs. Our dog can't wait to go every time and always goes in full of excitement. Plus, since he's a puppy, it's helping him so much to learn and socialize with other dogs. We couldn't be happier! 🐶❤️
We've found the best place to leave our dog. He loves it, always has a great time, and they're very careful. Highly recommended!
They are exceptional and loving. My furry friend is delighted with them.

I was looking for a place to take care of my dog ​​(who's already a senior) and after following them on Instagram for a while, I took her there and I don't regret it at all. You can tell they love their work and care for the dogs; they check in daily and keep you constantly informed about your pet's well-being. I'm delighted and enjoying my vacation, even though leaving an older dog in someone's care is always a bit of a worry. My dog ​​is one of the family, and it was important to me that she felt at home, and Guacanda has exceeded all expectations. Thank you so much for everything ❤️

Guacanda is a dog daycare that takes animal welfare seriously. They prioritize giving dogs an adjustment period and don't invest heavily in social media advertising, in my opinion, because where there's genuine commitment, there's no need to "sell" yourself. They are very attentive and understanding. A highly recommended place to entrust your dog's care.

It's fantastic for leaving your dog for a few hours when you can't take care of him because of something you need to take care of. He'll be looked after, taken for walks, socialized with other dogs, and have a great time. Excellent professionals and a very affordable price. I highly recommend it.
100% recommended, very friendly, my dog ​​was calm on his first day
The treatment is incredible and the service unbeatable. Mun couldn't be happier there, not to mention how easy they make my life. Long live Guacanda!
Fantastic. They're so caring with the dogs and so professional when explaining how things work. They keep you informed quickly about any issues and take care of everything.
Bady is very happy at Guacanda. She has a great time playing with the other dogs, and I couldn't be more at ease knowing she's in the hands of excellent professionals. I highly recommend them.

Lua is settling into her new doggy family, and Isa and Jesús are making it so much easier for her.
So happy to have discovered them! 😍🐾🐾 …

Very professional and attentive with the dogs. Methodical and careful. I like their gradual introduction plan where they assess the dog progressively before introducing it to everyone for extended periods. A very good option in Madrid for peace of mind.

A fantastic place to leave your dog! Even though mine is very attached and doesn't want to be separated, she goes in here on her own without any problem. You can tell they have a real knack for it and treat the dogs with great care. Highly recommended.
I loved it. The waiter who served me was very attentive. I'll be back.
I'm so happy with how the daycare has treated my furry friend. Finding them has truly been a blessing. I love their motto of letting them be dogs. I highly recommend them.
The service is 100% recommended; it's personalized. My Tay had never been left alone with anyone before, and whenever he stays at Guacanda, he's happy.
Despite being there for a reason unrelated to the business itself, they demonstrate great kindness and care for the furry friends inside! Packages are collected until 7 PM, please keep that in mind.

I've left my two dogs at the doggy daycare three times, and Isa has been incredibly loving with them, pampering and taking great care of them. I know I definitely need a place again where I can always leave them with them.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Brandon!

It was a pleasure to take the dog trainer training course.

They know how to care for animals; don't listen to the gossip.

If you want your dog to have a fun and happy time, this is the place for you. Jesús and Isa know exactly what they're doing.

I've been taking my dog ​​to Guacanda for two years now, and I couldn't be happier with the service. My dog ​​loves going there, and I always leave him exhausted from playing so much. He receives the best care, and they keep me informed about everything that happens (vomiting, diarrhea, behavior, etc.). I couldn't feel more at ease taking him to Guacanda. They are true professionals.

Our dog is a regular! He goes 3-4 times a week and is so happy! Many times he doesn't even say goodbye when he arrives… We were so lucky to find this place and the staff are wonderful! They even threw him a birthday party. It will definitely be his go-to daycare forever! ❤️
Thank you so much for your review, Bianca! It really helps us spread the word about our work and build trust with others. Best regards!
Thank you so much for your feedback, Iván! It's a great help in continuing our work. Best regards!

Great professionals and animal lovers. GUACANDA is a place where you can leave your dog with peace of mind, knowing they'll be cared for just as you would. Excellent service. THANK YOU from Willy and his mom 😉 …
We were very happy with our dog's stay at the doggy daycare. They kept us updated daily. We'll definitely be back! 😊 Thank you for taking such good care of her. …
Thank you so much for your feedback, Pilar! It helps us a lot in our work. Best regards!
Thank you for your feedback, Patricia. It's a shame we have no idea who you are so we can improve our service in the areas where you feel it doesn't deserve 5 stars. Best regards.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Marta! It helps us stay on track ;) Best regards!
Amazing service.
Thank you so much for your feedback, María Jesús!! It really helps us keep going ;)

Today I took my poodles, Leo and Sol, to doggy daycare for a little while. I really liked the staff's attitude. All three of us left so happy. We'll definitely be back from time to time. So happy! 🤩 …
Thank you so much for your feedback, Hugo! It really helps us continue our work and raise awareness. Hugs!

Excellent, friendly, and welcoming service. A well-organized team and highly professional staff. The dogs are well cared for, and the experience is very enriching for them. The price is reasonable. We are very happy with them.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Alfredo! It helps us continue our work. Best regards!
Thank you so much for your feedback, Lourdes! It helps us continue our work and raise awareness of our brand. Best regards!

I took my dog ​​and the experience was amazing!
Professional and attentive.
Very good price for the quality. I'll be a regular customer from now on.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Vicente! It's a great help to the business. Best regards.
It's a safe place for our dogs. My dog ​​goes there so happily and is always eager to go in.

We love the service they offer. They've adapted to our needs perfectly, and they've treated our dog wonderfully, helping her settle in quickly and stay happy, even though she's usually wary of strangers. They send us daily updates about Luna. Thank you for everything and for making it so easy to leave our little dog with them!

This place is wonderful. They care for the dogs from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. every day. They're very flexible: they offer overnight stays and will even pick them up from your home if you live nearby. Our dog, Melo, has a great time there because he's with his regular friends. They're always supervised (even with cameras), they take them for several walks a day, play with them, and send the owners photos and videos regularly. When you go to pick up your dog, they tell you about their day and keep a record of everything they've done. I often think Melo is happier there than at home.
Isabel was wonderful and walked my wolf beautifully. She saved my trip! Her love for animals and her professionalism are evident. I highly recommend her!
I only went to drop off a few things, but I saw how well the dogs are cared for. Great professionals.

It's a really good dog daycare. The staff there are very attentive to the animals and send photos and videos to the owners so they can see how their pets are doing. They also immediately report any issues or problems the staff has. Their prices for everything the owners need are very reasonable considering the quality of their services. I would definitely recommend it to any dog ​​owner who needs a place to leave their pet for a few days or even just a few hours.
The best place for your dogs to have some fun, and for you to do your things and not be able to take your dog with you.
Wonderful team, completely dedicated to the care of our dogs. 10 out of 10.

Fantastic experience! Luna stayed for 7 days. We were kept informed about her well-being, with photos and videos. She had a wonderful time. We are very grateful for your professionalism, kindness, and care. We will be back!
Thank you so much for changing your mind about the rating. We'll continue to help as much as we can ;)
Thank you so much for changing your mind about the rating. We'll continue to help as much as we can ;)
